integrity: The proof is algebraic: both the image and adjoint kernel are linear over the common fixed field GF(q^d), and a nonzero adjoint kernel is one-dimensional over that field. Finite exhaustive checks are included only as stress tests.
scientific_limitations: The dichotomy is proved only for the binomial Frobenius family \(\lambda X+\mu X^{q^k}\). It does not extend automatically to general multi-term linearized polynomials, and it does not replace the source trace-isotropy test for identifying the non-LCD parameters.
title: Full-parameter Frobenius image-code hulls have no intermediate dimensions
